init_inhouse_datastore: initialize an InhouseDatastore instance with a datastore root path to set up the SQLite database and tables
get_connection: get a thread-local SQLite database connection from the InhouseDatastore for executing queries
ensure_worker_exists: ensure a worker record exists in the workers table by worker_id, creating it if missing
set_worker_blocked: set the blocked status of a worker in the InhouseDatastore by their worker_id
get_worker_blocked: get the blocked status of a worker from the InhouseDatastore by their worker_id
